description: Activate when: user says 'the market is telling us X', 'valuation has dropped/risen so we should act', 'everyone is selling/buying so I should too', or is making an investment/fundraising decision based on a quoted price under emotional pressure. Do NOT activate when: the market quote genuinely reflects new economic information about the underlying business (not mood); or the user must transact at quoted price for forced-sale/liquidity reasons. More: deciqai.com/c/mr-market
